$comment: Owner class names that legitimately have no CSS rule of their own. Every entry needs a reason; keep this list short. Dynamic composition (owner-x--${variant}) is matched by the check itself and does not belong here.

classes.name: owner-reporting-export
classes.reason: Block identity hook on the CSV export board; its visuals come from owner-reporting-block and its behavior contract from [data-owner-reporting-export].

classes.name: owner-retained-disclosure__body
classes.reason: Unit-test query hook for the retained disclosure body; the disclosure owns its own visibility styling.

classes.name: owner-audit-state
classes.reason: State composition hook rendered with owner-state-panel--card; the loading/error/empty contract is expressed by [data-owner-audit-state].

classes.name: owner-audit-state--loading
classes.reason: Semantic state hook for the audit loading panel; visuals come from owner-state-panel--card and the skeleton.

classes.name: owner-audit-state--error
classes.reason: Semantic state hook for the audit error panel; visuals come from owner-state-panel--card.

classes.name: owner-audit-state--empty
classes.reason: Semantic state hook for the audit empty panel; visuals come from owner-state-panel--card.

classes.name: owner-health-state
classes.reason: State composition hook rendered with owner-state-panel--card; the variant contract is expressed by [data-owner-health-state].

classes.name: owner-health-state--
classes.reason: Dynamic state identity prefix used for semantic and test hooks; state visuals are owned by owner-state-panel--card and data-owner-health-state.

classes.name: owner-section-switch__panel--
classes.reason: Dynamic section identity prefix used for retained panel bookkeeping; panel styling is owned by owner-section-switch__panel and data attributes.

classes.name: owner-access-owners-summary
classes.reason: Identity hook styled by owner-access-card; only its --provision-open modifier needs a rule of its own.

classes.name: owner-access-inline--reset
classes.reason: Unit-test query hook for the inline PIN reset form; the form is styled through owner-access-inline.

classes.name: owner-chart__cutout
classes.reason: SVG geometry hook styled by element attributes, not a CSS rule.

classes.name: owner-chart__gap-stem
classes.reason: A local chart-state variable composes this SVG gap marker before it reaches className; its CSS rule is exercised by component and browser tests.

classes.name: owner-chart__gap-stem--missing
classes.reason: A local chart-state variable composes the missing-range modifier before it reaches className; its CSS rule is exercised by component and browser tests.

classes.name: owner-chart__gap-stem--closed
classes.reason: A local chart-state variable composes the closed-range modifier before it reaches className; its CSS rule is exercised by component and browser tests.

classes.name: owner-settings__control--error
classes.reason: The shared withErrorClass helper derives this modifier from the control base class at runtime; Settings tests exercise the invalid state.

classes.name: owner-settings__time--error
classes.reason: The shared withErrorClass helper derives this modifier from the time-field base class at runtime; Settings tests exercise the invalid state.

classes.name: owner-analytics-state--loading
classes.reason: Loading-state hook on the analytics board; visuals come from owner-analytics-state and owner-analytics-board.
